fact: On 17 June 2025 CCA Bank, Campost and FindMe signed an agreement to align the Plan de Localisation Postale with the bank's account-opening and credit processes, as part of building a national address database administrations can use.
title: Finance Week 2025 : CCA Bank, Campost et Findme s'associent pour optimiser le système d'adressage au Cameroun
